Game Overview

Right and Left is a arcade game built around dodge missiles in a fast-paced arcade thrill where quick reflexes reign supreme. Navigate using simple controls, jumping deftly to survive longer and climb the high score leaderboard. Adrenaline and agility define this addictive challenge; how far can you go before game over?

Playing Right and Left comes down to a simple loop. Dodge missiles in a fast-paced arcade thrill where quick reflexes reign supreme.
